name: Offline stationary-target approach decision contract

sampleFields.target: null or nonempty id and finite x,y,z

coordinateFrame.qualification: Fixture-defined frame; not verified game-world distance.

policy.meaning: Synthetic defaults, not experimentally tuned Rift gameplay thresholds

priorityRules: Reject unqualified provenance or any attempt to emit game commands.
Check sample field types, finite coordinates and strictly increasing time; invalid -> invalid-sample.
Target absent -> target-unavailable; changed identity -> target-changed.
Scene changed from initial sample -> scene-changed.
Consecutive sample time gap > staleAfterGapMs -> telemetry-stale.
Absolute player/target vertical difference > maximumVerticalDifferenceM -> height-unsafe.
Latest separation increases from prior valid distance by > movingAwayToleranceM -> moving-away.
No sufficient cumulative forward progress after progressWindowMs -> no-progress.
Otherwise output approach-intent (never a control command).

progressSemantics.movingAway: current horizontal distance minus previous valid horizontal distance > tolerance
progressSemantics.stalled: baseline-window distance minus current horizontal distance < minimumProgressM after progressWindowMs
progressSemantics.terminal: latch terminal state; subsequent samples yield ignored-after-terminal and never emit commands

outputContract.measurements: horizontal separation, height delta, elapsed time with synthetic units
outputContract.reproducibility: identical fixture + policy yields identical semantic JSON output

prohibitions: do not claim offline tests validate real-world navigation
owner: Manager only; workers must treat contract read-only
